<section class='av_textblock_section av-k2px09vy-44ffee34a44ba21cdcd033ec5898a7ee' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><p>The kite boarding area of ​​Porto Pollo is 900 meters as the crow flies from the Windsurf-Village. You can deposit your equipment or rent between over 40 sails and boards at the <strong>Porto Pollo Pro Center</strong> where expert instructors will be at your disposal.</p>
<p>Every day, in the period from June to September, at various times and with a predetermined program, a <strong>shuttle bus</strong> will offer you a round-up and return service <em>from </em>and <em>to </em>our structure.</p>

<section class='av_textblock_section av-k2px09vy-5-763776c554a70cab9edcc9ef504396ea' itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_textblock' itemprop="text" ><p>The kite boarding area of ​​Porto Pollo is 900 meters as the crow flies from the Windsurf-Village. You can deposit your equipment or rent between over 40 sails and boards at the <strong>MB Pro-Center</strong> where expert instructors will be at your disposal.</p>
<p>Every day, in the period from June to September, at various times and with a predetermined program, a <strong>shuttle bus</strong> will offer you a round-up and return service <em>from </em>and <em>to </em>our structure.</p>
</div></section></div><div class='flex_column av-gpifs-4-b4d80852be7c7d688a987d055101825c av_one_full avia-builder-el-27 el_after_av_one_full avia-builder-el-last first flex_column_div shadow-not-animated column-top-margin' ><div class='avia-image-container av-k35p91kd-3-7d248e59cf90ff52a1da85384727e63a av-styling- avia-align-center avia-builder-el-28 avia-builder-el-no-sibling ' itemprop="image" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/ImageObject" ><div class="avia-image-container-inner"><div class="avia-image-overlay-wrap"><img decoding="async" class='wp-image-1093 avia-img-lazy-loading-not-1093 avia_image ' src="https://www.windsurfvillage.it/source_/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/kite-zone-2.jpg" alt='' title='kite zone' height="648" width="1275" itemprop="thumbnailUrl" srcset="https://www.windsurfvillage.it/source_/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/kite-zone-2.jpg 1275w, https://www.windsurfvillage.it/source_/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/kite-zone-2-300x152.jpg 300w, https://www.windsurfvillage.it/source_/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/kite-zone-2-768x390.jpg 768w, https://www.windsurfvillage.it/source_/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/kite-zone-2-1030x523.jpg 1030w, https://www.windsurfvillage.it/source_/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/kite-zone-2-705x358.jpg 705w, https://www.windsurfvillage.it/source_/wp-content/uploads/2019/11/kite-zone-2-450x229.jpg 450w" sizes="(max-width: 1275px) 100vw, 1275px" /></div></div></div></div>
</div></div></div></div></div><div id='after_section_2' class='main_color av_default_container_wrap container_wrap fullsize' ><div class='container av-section-cont-open' ><div class='template-page content av-content-full alpha units'><div class='post-entry post-entry-type-page post-entry-1832'><div class='entry-content-wrapper clearfix'></p>
<div class='flex_column av-3ww208-4cc07f837c8c0dc70d6d17093f94399d av_one_full avia-builder-el-29 el_after_av_section el_before_av_section avia-builder-el-no-sibling first no_margin flex_column_div ' ><section class="avia_codeblock_section avia_code_block_0" itemscope="itemscope" itemtype="https://schema.org/CreativeWork" ><div class='avia_codeblock ' itemprop="text" ><div id="wid_1745408780141"></div>
